notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #38: An Open Letter to All from 《Wild Assault》
notes.notes: [h3]Dear Wild Ones,[/h3][p][/p][p]We hope this letter finds you well.[/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to every player who has stood by [i]Wild Assault[/i]. Your feedback, every battle you’ve fought, and every suggestion you’ve shared on our forums and community platforms have been the driving force behind our continuous efforts to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Recently, our team’s focus has shifted to a new phase of development. We’ve dedicated most of our resources to enhancing [b]Custom Rooms[/b], designing [b]new maps[/b], and optimizing [b]core gameplay experiences[/b]. However, due to limited development capacity, some of the originally planned content—such as large-scale events—will be adjusted in scale. The specific changes are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p]1、The [b]content volume of the Battle Pass will be significantly reduced[/b]. We will also [b]lower its price[/b] and transition it into a [b]self-sustaining model[/b].[/p][p]2、The development progress of the [b]Snow Leopard hero has fallen behind schedule[/b] due to higher-than-expected complexity. We will need [b]more time to refine this hero[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]That said, we’re excited to confirm that the [b]Snowfield Map will be released as scheduled[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Moving forward, we will continue to adopt an [b]iterative and agile approach[/b] to updates, ensuring all plans are communicated transparently through official announcements.[/p][p][/p][p]To our dedicated players: the story of [i]Wild Assault [/i]is far from over. Our inbox and community channels remain open to you—every suggestion you offer could become a critical reference for our next phase of adjustments.[/p][p]We sail together through storms, and the future remains bright.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The Combat Cat Studio[/p][p]September 19, 2025[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #37: ENTANGLED-ERWIN
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/ac76c866484af40dbd7f3d34d42895477bf06741.png"][/img][/p][p align="center"][b][i]Erwin will keep you company, meow![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p]In our last Wild Assault Dev Log， we gave you a comprehensive look at the latest development of our new snow map. Today, let’s return to the perspective of our animal heroes and dive deeper into[b] ERWIN[/b] — a formidable female hero who shares the same tactical role as [b]Hong Ying![/b][/p][p]Stay tuned for more insights 🐾✨[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Profile[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Physique[/b]: SLIM BODY[/p][/*][*][p][b]Role[/b]: SUPPORT[/p][/*][*][p][b]Abilities[/b]:[/p][p][b]Tactical(Q) — UNSPOKEN TRUTH[/b][/p][p]Erwin switches to the Rescue Glove, linking to an ally within range and continuously restoring their HP. Hold LMB to select an ally and heal them, the healing effect strengthens after a sustained period. Hold RMB to heal yourself. The link breaks and healing stops if the distance between the two exceeds a certain limit. Within the link's range, this skill can also revive downed allies.[/p][p][b]SIGNATURE(E) — SIDE BY SIDE LOYALTY[/b][/p][p]When activated, Erwin moves faster and provides enhanced healing to her teammates.[/p][p][b]Ultimate (Z) — POWER OF BONDS[/b][/p][p]Erwin selects an ally and throws a can of her favorite catnip "Rapture," enhancing their status. Under the effects of "Rapture," the ally gains increased max HP and faster reload speed. If the ally with "Rapture" is taken down, the effect is passed on to the nearest ally within range, continuing until there are no nearby allies to inherit it.[/p][p][b]Passive — DANGER![/b][/p][p]Movement speed is increased for a short period of time when taking damage.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Compatible Guns:[/b][/p][p]Assault Rifle[/p][p]Submachine Guns[/p][p]Shotguns[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Story[/b][/h3][p][b]AIVI[/b] — no, [b]Erwin[/b] is the daughter of the Desolate Legion commander. During a mission in a war-torn region, Erwin discovered AIVI buried under rubble, barely alive, and begged her family to take her in.[/p][p]Thus, AIVI entered the Desolate Legion and began living alongside Erwin . Unsurprisingly, they became close friends — yet despite their inseparable bond, the two were fundamentally different. Erwin had been strictly raised with impeccable manners, speech, and style, while AIVI had known only instability and displacement since childhood. Grateful to Erwin ’s family for saving her, AIVI also grew deeply enamored with Erwin herself — even secretly imitating her elegant tone and gestures when alone. She often whispered to herself: [i]“[/i]AIVI[i] wants to become Erwin. Erwin wants to become [/i]AIVI[i].”[/i][/p][p]Then Erwin took her own life. Now, years later, AIVI can hardly recall how she learned of Erwin ’s death. What followed was her acceptance of “modifications” and “training” imposed by Erwin ’s parents — all to sustain their delusion that their daughter was still alive, a fantasy AIVI herself desperately embraced.[/p][p]Through years of intense physical and mental reshaping, AIVI’s original identity faded, replaced by “Erwin ” — a mercenary fighting for the Desolate Legion under Erwin’s name.[/p][p]Now, Erwin is AIVI. AIVI is Erwin.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Battlefield Statistics[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Total Combat Hours Since Early Access[/b]: 72,709 hours[/p][/*][*][p][b]Win Rate[/b]: 63.31%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Average K/D[/b]: 2.02[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kills per Match[/b]: 14.5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deaths per Match[/b]: 4.2[/p][/*][*][p][b]Average Score per Match[/b]: 5570[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement Completion Rate[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][i]“[/i]Stable Link[i]”——4.1%[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]“You've Been Buffed! Go Charge!”[/i]——5.0%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Strategy & Tactics[/b][/h3][p][b]Battlefield Role[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pure Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Frontline Aggressor[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Utilizes the mobility of the E skill to actively operate on the front lines, frequently switching between self-healing (via Q skill) and healing teammates to rapidly charge the ultimate ability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Advantage[/b]: Accelerates the "initiation tempo" of core allies, making it ideal for aggressive team compositions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Rearguard Supporter[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Leverages obstacles and the extended rescue range of the Q skill to provide remote healing from safe positions, acting as the team’s "perpetual transfusion machine."[/p][/*][*][p][b]Advantage[/b]: Maximizes survival assurance, suited for conservative push strategies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Skill Strategies[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tactical(Q) [/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fires a healing beam that can restore health and rescue allies from long range. Requires maintaining aim during channeling.[/p][/*][*][p]Ideal for sustained healing in positional battles or emergency frontline rescues (recommended with the [i]Rescue Acceleration[/i] talent).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SIGNATURE(E) [/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Grants a brief high movement speed boost, suitable for disengaging, repositioning, or emergency evasion. When combined with the [i]Speed Boost When Hit[/i] passive, it enables rapid relocation and significantly improves survival efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ultimate (Z)[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Enhances a single ally with increased max health and reload speed, boosting their solo combat capability. If the enhanced ally dies, the effect transfers to the nearest nearby friendly unit.[/p][list][*][p][b]Primary Targets[/b]: Assault cores (e.g., Tiger, Fox) — amplifies their engagement mobility and sustained damage output.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secondary Targets[/b]: Heavy specialists (e.g., Bear, Panda) — creates a high-durability "fixed turret" to compensate for their low mobility.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Weapon Recommendations[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Balanced DPS：M-90[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mid-close suppression (versatile)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/09b8987a32cd4467250fada4ae4c378a3f893ebc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]CQC Burst： Shotgun / M-10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tight-space rushes (needs precise movement)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/09b8987a32cd4467250fada4ae4c378a3f893ebc.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/8b497a09f1ffc0ddb35f64c63bfabcbf48371b24.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Sustain Control：PS-29 / PPSH-45[/b][/p][list][*][p]Suppressive fire (ammo efficiency)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/c0fd9f84b94b045c4e2e51d10b40087fc1206b7e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/4e2db23821ddefd22b5b133becbc008ef6ddcdea.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Survival Techniques[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Weakness Warning[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Erwin highly relies on teammate cover. Her support/combat switching time is long. When ambushed, prioritize using her E skill to reposition behind cover or create speed advantage for evasive maneuvers, avoiding direct gunfire and preemptive damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Team Composition[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Recommended to synergize with high-mobility assault roles or crowd-control specialists. Avoid isolated exposure.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Talent Selection[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Prioritize speed-enhancing talents based on playstyle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]In summary[/b][/p][p]Erwin is the unsung engine of team victory—she may lack flashy kill stats, but every healing beam and every game-changing support she provides can turn the tide of battle. Mastering her dual playstyles will make you the most indispensable guardian on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][p]That's all. Join us again next week! If you have suggestions or ideas for [b]Erwin[/b], please share your feedback with us! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][p]Meow! A little Easter egg—see you next Thursday (September 18th). Don’t miss it! 🐾🎮[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/b9e082793203b34720ccc6bacca9221e1efadc11.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #36: New Map
notes.notes: [p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p]It's time for Wild Assault Dev Log. This week, we’re unveiling a highly anticipated highlight—the development progress of a [b]new map[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Overall Progress: Final Phase Initiated[/b][/h3][p]As of yesterday, the fifth map has completed its [b]basic packaging[/b] and officially entered the final [b]testing and polishing stage[/b]! This means [i]Wild Assault [/i]is about to welcome another strategic battlefield.[/p][p]True to our promise, each map aims to deliver a [b]distinct combat experience[/b]. From early maps emphasizing "open-world exploration," "terrain-based tactics," "multi-level platform combat," to "linear assault rhythms," this time—[b]vertical terrain tactics[/b] will be the core soul of the new map![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Theme & Core Mechanics: Vertical Warfare in the Snowy Mountains[/b][/h3][p]Valiant will venture into [b]high-altitude snowy mountains[/b], battling amidst icy cliffs, harsh winds, and treacherous terrain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/89286b8cfde1201b76261e771a91966d5f2db39d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Core Gameplay:[/b][/p][p]•[b]Vertical Terrain Advantage[/b]: Height differences will be key to attack/defense—holding high ground can suppress enemies but may also expose you to multi-directional assaults.[/p][p]•[b]Multi-Route Design[/b]: The notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #35: Custom Lobby Latest News
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Wild Ones![/b][/p][p]It's time for Wild Assault Dev Log. In the past two editions, we took a deep dive into two of our Valiants. [/p][p]This week, we're switching gears to bring you the latest on our new content development. This edition is all about the progress of our Custom Lobby feature.[/p][p][/p][p]First up, in the version currently under development, you can already see the room list. Once this feature goes live, all the rooms you create will be displayed here. You'll be able to browse room information and join whichever room catches your fancy. Furthermore, we've added a precise search function, allowing you to find a specific room directly by its Room ID.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/93f6fe5dc8903d8a7c42dc15d7012470ee8c35f5.png"][/img]After entering a room, you'll arrive at the pre-game lobby. This space is primarily for everyone to prepare before a match. You can see all members in the room, including the character models. Additionally, you can communicate with everyone in the room via the lobby chat channel and adjust team assignments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/539eaf12bb04232c832db0e894f9c8c1b852ab38.png"][/img]As the Room Owner, you'll have the ability to adjust room settings. This includes changing the mode and map, and configuring gameplay rules.[/p][p]Now, let's give you a sneak peek with a few screenshots:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bot Settings[/b][/p][p]You can choose whether to add bots to a match, and even select to add them only for one side. You can also set the difficulty for bots, with 50 difficulty levels available for you to choose from.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/75baf9b4fe4f6832d123b78d97863e283977a8ed.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Valiant Settings[/b][/p][p]Regarding match settings, you might be particularly interested in what can be adjusted for Valiants. We're providing many options for you. For example, as seen in the screenshot below, you can modify skill cooldown times or ultimate charge rates. You can also choose to disable a certain type of skill or outright ban specific Valiants. We believe that with various combinations of these settings, you'll be able to create all sorts of interesting experiences.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/aa4c7586ceffcf7c5b2dc439bca7eca7db970162.png"][/img][/p][p]Besides the content mentioned above, many other custom options for rooms are currently in development. We also welcome everyone to contribute ideas and let us know what options you most want to see. We will continue to update and strive to meet your expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]Join us again next week! If you have suggestions or ideas for it, please share your feedback with us! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: ​​R&D Priority Alignment Update​
notes.notes:
[p]To All Valiants, 

Thank you for your continuous feedback! We have carefully listened to the community's concerns regarding core experience pain points—bot mechanics, weapon balancing, foundational gameplay, controller compatibility, and more. In the past, we overly focused on developing new content while neglecting the optimization of core experiences. We have deeply reflected on this. 

Now, We will adjust our update strategy and development rhythm as follows: 
1.Reprioritization​ – The team will fully dedicate efforts to optimizing core experiences (bot logic improvements, foundational gameplay, controller support, etc.). 
2.Agile Update Strategy​ – Due to our limited team size, we will adopt a "small steps, quick iterations" approach: features will be released as soon as they are completed, rather than waiting for large bundled updates. 
3.Continuous Content Iteration​ – Future new content, such as custom rooms, new maps, and new Valiants currently in development, will also follow the "finish first, update first" strategy. 

Here’s a preview: The first round of bot optimizations is planned for release next week. We also encourage everyone to share your feedback on bot experiences in the comments. We will prioritize these optimizations in future updates.  [/p]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #34: MEDIC ANGEL-HONG YING
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/58f38a76693b319116e8f777bade7dc80f59d7e2.png"][/img][b][i]                                                           Easy now. I'll patch you up![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello Wild Ones![/b][/p][p]Our last Wild Assault Dev Log brought us closer to MARQUEZ. Today, we unveil another Valiant entwined with his destiny—[b]HONG YING[/b], a soul bound to MARQUEZ by deep bonds.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Profile[/b][/h1][p][b]Physique[/b]: SLIM BODY[/p][p][b]Role[/b]: UPPORT[/p][p][b]Abilities[/b]:[/p][p][b]Tactical(Q) — FIRST AID CAPSULE[/b][/p][p]Throws a medical device to heal allies. The device will be retrieved upon reuse or expiration, restoring HP to teammates nearby. When the medical device detects a downed ally nearby, it releases smoke around.[/p][p][b]SIGNATURE(E) — COMBAT ROLL[/b][/p][p]HONG YING rolls in the designated direction.[/p][p][b]Ultimate (Z) —ANGEL DASH[/b][/p][p]HONG YING rushes to aid allied units at all costs, increasing base movement speed while unleashing the power of the potions in her backpack. Continuously restores health to allied units within range and slightly increases their maximum health. During the effect duration, she will automatically rescue dying teammates within the skill's range.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/23273edbe47ee2c4078c55bdf321cecc0f7c6720.png"][/img][b]Passive — DANGER![/b][/p][p]Movement speed is increased for a short period of time when being shot at.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Compatible Guns: [/b]Submachine Guns\\Shotguns[/p][p][/p][h1]Story[/h1][p]HONG YING was born into an ancient lineage of healers. From her earliest years, she absorbed pharmacological texts under her parents' guidance, her fingers tracing characters older than dynasties. Yet books became her true sanctuary—within their pages, she journeyed across snow-swept peaks and stormy oceans, traversing realms no child’s feet could tread.[/p][p][/p][p]A shadow lingered in this idyllic world: her parents’ absence. Her mother, LIAN HUA, conducted research at an institute HONG YING had visited only once—a labyrinth of humming machines and stern-faced scholars. Though family whispers praised LIAN HUA as a brilliant scientist whose work saved thousands, she returned home but rarely. Her father remained an enigma, his existence a question mark in her childhood.[/p][p][/p][p]Then came the day investigators stormed their home. Afterward, LIAN HUA vanished—no explanations, no farewells. The silence suffocated HONG YING.[/p][p][/p][p]Years passed. Fragmented clues led her to the truth: her mother had worked at the [i]Huli BioTech[/i], destroyed years prior in an explosion that erased both facilities and lives. LIAN HUA was listed among the missing. Defying her family’s pleas, HONG YING fled into the night, determined to unearth the ruins.[/p][p][/p][p]Beyond her sheltered world, war had scorched the land. Streets lay gutted, echoing with the groans of wounded civilians. HONG YING’s medical kit could mend flesh, but each bandage felt futile—[i]new wounds bloomed daily like cursed flowers[/i]. True healing, she realized, demanded extinguishing war’s fire at its source.[/p][p][/p][p]This revelation guided her to the [i]Desolate Legion[/i], a rebel force fighting the chaos. There, during a moonless operation, HONG YING dragged a bleeding Valiant from crossfire—a man named Marquez. As her hands stanched his wounds, destiny’s gears shuddered and turned.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Battlefield Statistics[/b][/h1][p][b]Total Combat Hours Since Early Access[/b]: 85,256 hours[/p][p][b]Win Rate[/b]: 61%[/p][p][b]Average K/D[/b]: 2.88[/p][p][b]Kills per Match[/b]: 21[/p][p][b]Deaths per Match[/b]: 8.5[/p][p][b]Average Score per Match[/b]: 5801[/p][p][b]Achievement Completion Rate[/b]:[/p][p][i]    “Just Save 'Em All”——7.62%[/i][/p][p][i]    “Sustained Healing”[/i]——1.31%[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Strategy & Tactics[/b][/h1][p][b]Battlefield Role[/b][/p][p][b]    Hybrid Support-Carry[/b] (Combat/Healing dual role)[/p][p][b]    Mobility[/b]: Passive + short-range dash for quick repositioning (retreating, flanking, crossfire setups)[/p][p][b]    High Risk[/b]: Small hitbox (low margin for error), limited weapon range (close-quarters focus), relies on mechanics & reflexes[/p][p][/p][p][b]Skill Strategies[/b][/p][p][b]    Tactical:[/b][/p][p]    Deploy for area healing; retracting instantly restores HP[/p][p]    Triggers smoke screen when reviving downed allies (ideal for bunker fights or clutch saves—pair with [i]Quick Revive [/i]talent)[/p][p]    Use to sustain peek-fire duels (health advantage)[/p][p][b]    SIGNATURE:[/b][/p][p]    Short teleport + hit-triggered speed boost for dueling (dodge key abilities or initiate fights)[/p][p][b]   [/b] Pro Tip: Cast at ledge edges to extend distance via momentum[/p][p][b]    Ultimate: [/b][/p][p]    AOE heal-over-time + speed buff; auto-revives nearby downed allies[/p][p]    Best for: Push coordination / defensive sustain (combos with Tactical for [i]"Double-Heal Loop"[/i])[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Recommendations[/b][/p][p][b]    Balanced DPS: M-90[/b][/p][p]    Mid-close suppression (versatile)[/p][p][b]    [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/6b9c18a62700361bab77e38febaedaadaf5e63b9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]    CQC Burst: Shotgun / M-10[/b][/p][p]    Tight-space rushes (needs precise movement)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/8df1bdf2d526ef60b2d057c9ddd77630f3b20c5f.png"][/img]    [b]Sustain Control: PS-29 / PPSH-45[/b][/p][p]    Suppressive fire (ammo efficiency)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/59abf1d91f738c66986570b686b1cf5df19319a0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Survival Techniques[/b][/p][p][b]    [/b]Abuse mobility skills to dodge projectiles (small hitbox = fragile)[/p][p][b]    [/b]Cover Synergy: Healing Field smoke → Blink Dash back to cover[/p][p][/p][p][b]Team Synergy[/b][/p][p][b]    [/b]With Assault/Tanks: Smoke-covered pushes + ult-assisted charges[/p][p][b]    [/b]With Controllers: Flank with dash to create crossfire angles[/p][p][/p][p]That's all. Join us again next week! If you have suggestions or ideas for [b]HONG YING[/b], please share your feedback with us! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #33: DEADLY TOXIN-MARQUEZ
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/7dacd0042d88adb82207aa47fa4b9c0a66ad281e.png"][/img][b][i]                                                You wanna know what gives life meaning?[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello Wild Ones![/b][/p][p]Today we've released the Season 2 Valiant usage stats, with [b]MARQUEZ[/b] emerging as the most popular Valiant. For this week's Wild Assault Dev Log, we're trying something different! Let's delve into a comprehensive understanding of our very own [b]Dr. MARQUEZ[/b]![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Profile[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/9d3c8c5220d33a49e8bddffcc8134d9cc29f93bd.png"][/img][b]Physique[/b]: SLIM BODY[/p][p][b]Role[/b]: Specialist[/p][p][b]Abilities[/b]:[/p][p][b]Tactical(Q) — GAS GRENADE[/b][/p][p]    Marquez fires a toxin gas grenade that deals damage to nearby enemies and creates a toxin gas area that lasts for a period of time. Enemies inhaling the gas take damage over time (DOT) and experience reduced movement speed.[/p][p][b]SIGNATURE(E) — TOXIN TRAP[/b][/p][p]    Marques deploy toxin mine, dealing AOE damage and DOT toxin damage to enemies.[/p][p][b]Ultimate (Z) —TOXIN LOCKDOWN[/b][/p][p]    Marquez fires multiple deadly toxin bombs at a certain area, locking it down. Enemies within the area take a certain amount of DOT damage. Use right mouse button to switch between different firing modes.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/acc7f2417293df9b217dd04295b60333ef69c178.png"][/img][b]Passive — TOXIN STIMULATION[/b][/p][p]    When attacked, Marquez accelerates venom secretion, reducing the remaining cooldown time of current abilities.[/p][p][b]Compatible Guns: [/b]Submachine Guns\\Marksman Rifles\\Shotguns[/p][p][/p][h1]Story[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Childhood[/b]:[/p][p]Marquez faced constant criticism for everything he did, gradually developing an obsessive pursuit of perfection. To others, Marquez appeared flawless and relentless—always muttering, [i]"No, not enough yet."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Career at Huli BioTech[/b]:[/p][p]As an adult, Marquez became a researcher at the Biotechnology Institute, working under [b]Lianhua[/b] (mother of [b]HongYing[/b]) on bioengineering projects. Despite repeated rejections of Marquez' research proposals, Lianhua supported Marquez in continuing her work.[/p][p]The institute specialized in studying the Feral Relic—a substance with dual potential for medical applications and toxicological research. Its work spanned two divisions:[/p][p]    Medical Division (exploring therapeutic uses)[/p][p]    Toxins Division (studying hazardous properties)[/p][p]Driven by a desire to surpass her mentor, Marquez grew increasingly fixated on breakthroughs. To accelerate progress, Marquez secretly conducted illegal experiments in abandoned labs. Though Lianhua urged Marquez to stop, the institute’s leadership tacitly endorsed the methods due to dramatically improved reagent efficiency. This rift deepened their conflict.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rise and Fall[/b]:[/p][p]Marquez’s exceptional talent soon secured a role in the institute’s top-secret [b]Project Genesis[/b]. Leading the team, Marquez developed a reagent that enhanced soldiers’ physical capabilities for combat. When questioned about side effects, Marquez consistently evaded answers.[/p][p]The lab was eventually raided by law enforcement. The only stable reagent sample vanished—prompting Marquez to inject the remaining unstable solution into herself, declaring: [i]"I will reclaim everything I've lost someday."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Desolate Legion and Hidden Motives[/b]:[/p][p]Rescued by [b]HongYing[/b] during an Desolate Legion mission, Marquez recognized [b]HongYing[/b] as [b]Lianhua[/b]’s daughter (having seen photos in [b]Lianhua[/b]’s office). Though [b]HongYin[/b] remained unaware, Marquez silently monitored her—whispering, [i]"You disapprove of my methods, don’t you, little bunny?"[/i][/p][p]While the [b]Desolate Legion[/b] sought to hoard the Feral Relic resources to create superweapons and end wars, Marquez predicted they would instead dominate the world through threats. Thus began Marquez’s covert plan to undermine them...[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Battlefield Statistics[/b][/h1][p][b]Total Combat Hours Since Early Access[/b]: 116,166 hours[/p][p][b]Win Rate[/b]: 57.55%[/p][p][b]Average K/D[/b]: 3.17[/p][p][b]Kills per Match[/b]: 32[/p][p][b]Deaths per Match[/b]: 9.76[/p][p][b]Average Score per Match[/b]: 6,868[/p][p][b]Achievement Completion Rate[/b]:[/p][p][i]    "Toxic Buffet"[/i]: 13.86%[/p][p][i]    "Never Ending"[/i]: 2.49%[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Strategy & Tactics[/b][/h1][p][b]Battlefield Role[/b][/p][p][b]    Suppress Health Levels[/b]: Weaken enemy sustainability and hinder recovery capabilities.[/p][p][b]    Stabilize Frontlines[/b]: Disrupt enemy assaults/counterattacks through area denial.[/p][p][b]    Territorial Control[/b]: Gradually encroach on enemy positions using zone control tactics .[/p][p][/p][p][b]Skill Strategies[/b][/p][p][b]    Tactical(Q) — GAS GRENADE[/b]:[/p][p]    Deploy in chokepoints to block paths or apply preemptive slow.[/p][p]    Cover high-cover positions to force repositioning.[/p][p][b]    SIGNATURE(E)[/b]:[/p][p]    Conceal in bushes, corners, or objective zones for ambushes.[/p][p][b]    Ultimate (Z)[/b]:[/p][p]    Split the battlefield to isolate targets during team pushes or cut off retreat routes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Recommendations[/b][/p][p][b]    Offensive Focus (Aggressive Playstyle)[/b]:[b]Submachine Guns (MAC-10) / Shotguns (AKS)[/b]:[/p][p]    Capitalize on Q  for close-range duels.[/p][p]    Use E for intel gathering/slowing advances.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/bee919f3a8c6867d1fd1f5169fd849d30bc8c063.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/18a3df7f83e4c1a9693de506b1c5862f8756c8ae.png"][/img][/p][p][b]    [/b][/p][p][b]Control Focus (Mid-Range Dominance)[/b]:[b]Marksman Rifles (VSK-92)[/b]:[/p][p]    Suppress enemies at medium range with precision fire.[/p][p]    Combine Q+Z to lock down movement during pushes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/c4771ae99e96fd9ced8e8fa413a4912fe9f4ec7a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Survival Techniques[/b][/p][p]    Leverage SLIM BODY for evasive maneuvers; maintain optimal engagement distance.[/p][p]    Prioritize cover utilization and repositioning to offset low HP (120) .[/p][p][/p][p][b]Team Synergy[/b][/p][p][b]    With Healers[/b]: Compensate for low sustain (e.g., pair with HongYing's AOE healing).[/p][p][b]    With Scouts[/b]: Enhance area control via enemy positioning intel.[/p][p][b]    With Tanks[/b]: Deploy poison clouds to cover heavily-armored assaults (e.g., Ryan's charges)[/p][p][/p][p]That's all. Join us again next week! If you have suggestions or ideas for [b]MARQUEZ[/b], please share your feedback with us! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #32: Custom Lobby Introduction
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/7ca2cf1dbbc7c5ea834a15b00c598f55b7812955.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p]It's time for Wild Assault Dev Log. Today, we're revealing a feature currently in development: [b]Custom Lobby[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Feature Introduction[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Custom Lobby feature allows players to create their own game rooms and customize a variety of settings for their matches.[/p][/*][*][p]This feature has two primary goals:[/p][list][*][p]To help players easily team up, chat, and compete with friends;[/p][/*][*][p]To tailor matches to personal preferences.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Design Details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player-created rooms will appear in a room list. Players can browse this list and join rooms created by others.[/p][/*][*][p]When creating a room, players can select their preferred game mode and maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Beyond mode and map selection, additional detailed settings are available, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Number of players of the match[/p][/*][*][p]Attributes and ability of the Valiant[/p][/*][*][p]BOT parameters[/p][/*][*][p]Mode rules parameters[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Through these settings, players can create their ideal gameplay experience. For example:[/p][list][*][p]Matches that limit Valiant selection[/p][/*][*][p]Human vs. BOT matches[/p][/*][*][p]Matches with modified skill cooldowns for an "ULTRA SKILL" mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Current Development Progress[/b][/p][list][*][p]Our team is hard at work on this feature. Below are some sneak peeks from the design phase to give you an early look.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/4b7f8a1b907ca1a73041956bd760506b1ad0abda.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/6dd8edb2752ce37c49b7c4da35ac30ac8e30a411.png"][/img][/p][p]That's all about the Custom Lobby. Join us again next week! If you have suggestions or ideas for it, please share your feedback with us! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/WildAssaultGame"]https://x.com/WildAssaultGame[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/WildAssault"]https://discord.gg/WildAssault[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #31: Update on Recent R&D
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/7ca2cf1dbbc7c5ea834a15b00c598f55b7812955.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones, TGIF![/p][p]We'd like to take some time to talk more with you about the changes we implemented through this week's updates.[/p][p]First of all, a little background here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506209223025098791"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506208679022821566"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As you've read, before deploying the weekly update, we conducted our balancing plan based on the following factors:[/p][list][*][p]Community Survey Statistics[/p][/*][*][p]Internal Discussions[/p][/*][*][p]Feasibility Validations[/p][/*][*][p]Internal Tests[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A lot of work has been done behind the scenes, and that's how we carried out the plan and made the announcement in previous Steam News posts. However, [b]what's more important is how these adjustments truly perform in the live environment.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]After announcing the adjustment plan, we continued further testing of its performance while collecting your feedback through multiple social media platforms. [b]This allowed us to more clearly see that certain adjustments were not performing as expected in the actual game. Therefore, we modified the weekly update announcement accordingly, based on our live experience and data.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Once again, [b]we believe that constant optimization and adjustment plans are crucial for this journey.[/b] In order to keep polishing the project while providing you with an entertaining gameplay experience, [b]we plan to further advance the testing schedule for every round of optimizations in the future.[/b] Hopefully, by slightly adjusting the R&D process, your feedback can help us refine the adjustments more directly. [b]By doing so, it will be easier for us to provide you with an overall satisfying game experience each new season.[/b] Thank you again for all your help. notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #30: Season 2 Adjustment Plan!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/7ca2cf1dbbc7c5ea834a15b00c598f55b7812955.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones! [b]#TGIF![/b][/p][p]How's it going? We hope you're having fun playing [b]Wild Assault Season 2: Phantom Fracture![/b] We're so glad our weekly dev log is back![/p][p]In this episode, we'll continue to update you on what's been happening in the studio over the past few weeks. Specifically, we want to talk about the [b]survey[/b] we released right after Season 2 launched. Without further ado, let's dive into your new season feedback and discuss the adjustments we've made based on the data collected regarding your content preferences![/p][p][/p][h1]Season 2 Overall Performance & Further Plans[/h1][p][/p][p]First of all, here are the player satisfaction ratings for Season 2, based on the survey results. [b]Thank you to the 2,500+ players who took the survey and shared your thoughts in detail with us![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Valiant Balancing Satisfaction[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/9362141d1aefd74301d0a3f64c18e5e1772f9feb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Balancing Satisfaction[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/2486f2145991e7808e5829feee84d267933ef513.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Mapping Out the Plan[/h2][p][/p][p]By analyzing the recent survey results and having several rounds of internal discussions, we've gradually come up with the following adjustment plan. We'd like to share the details with you and see if you like what we're about to do![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Valiant Balancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Akai Hime[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tactical Ability: Encounter[/p][list][*][p][b]Survivability[/b]: Akai Hime now has 50% damage reduction while stealthed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Crock - The Mire Butcher[/b][/p][list][*][p]Signature Ability: Dark Water Strike[/p][list][*][p][b]Survivability[/b]: Decreased Crock's damage reduction while the ability is active: 80% → 30%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Erwin - The Entangled[/b][/p][list][*][p]Signature Ability: Unspoken Truth[/p][list][*][p]New Trait: Erwin gains increased movement speed for a short period when the ability is activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hongying - The Medic Angel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tactical Ability: First Aid Capsule[/p][list][*][p][b]New Trait:[/b] When the First Aid Capsule detects nearby downed allies, it now releases smoke to cover friendly units.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Norman - The Lost Claw[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tactical Ability: Shock Roar[/p][list][*][p][b]Range Adjustment:[/b] Decreased the damage radius of the Shock Roar.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ryan - The Tough Cop[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Repression[/p][list][*][p][b]CQB Effectiveness:[/b] Significantly increased the reload speed of Ryan's Ultimate Ability exclusive weapon, the Sawed-Off Shotgun.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Vladimir - The Righteous Flame[/b][/p][list][*][p]Signature Ability: Field Fort[/p][list][*][p][b]Ability Cooldown Adjustment:[/b] When Vladimir interacts with the Field Fort, his Tactical Ability cooldown is instantly reduced by 60%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapon Balancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Assault Rifles[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased overall hip-fire spread.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized overall gun feel, reducing excessive recoil shake.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]DMRs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased overall hip-fire spread.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased MK4's fire rate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SMGs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased SMGs' hip-fire accuracy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shotguns[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shotguns are no longer available to Vladimir and Zhenshan.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reverted Shotgun close-range performance to ensure consistent eliminations for slim body Valiants within 10m and effective damage within 15m (1m≈3.28ft).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Snipers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted NTW-Proto's damage multipliers for different body parts:[/p][list][*][p]Chest: 1x damage (150)[/p][/*][*][p]Upper Stomach: 1x damage (150)[/p][/*][*][p]Left/Right Arm: 0.7x damage (105)[/p][/*][*][p]Left/Right Leg: 0.7x damage (105)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Attachments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overall adjustments have been made to weapon attachment sets and their stats, along with improved descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon attachments will now influence firearm capabilities in multiple areas, including handling (recoil, minimum and maximum spread, and spread increase rate), firepower (weapon range), and mobility (weapon readiness from sprint to fire and ADS speed). They will provide an overall positive bonus to firearms.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other Things We've Learned from the Survey[/h2][p][/p][p]From the survey results, we can see that many players have high expectations for the following new features:[/p][list][*][p][b]Custom lobbies [/b]are very much anticipated by half of the survey takers. We're starting related R&D soon while carefully considering the potential player base fragmentation issues you've raised.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PvE[/b] is also in the plan! Please rest assured that Wild Assault's core game modes will continue to evolve. We also plan to introduce more casual game modes to enrich your experience in the future.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customized UX: [/b]It looks like many survey takers are also interested in Valiant Customization, Valiant Interaction Experiences (petting WHEN?), and the Steam Workshop, etc. Your wish is our command! Related R&D is already in progress![/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimization & Bug Fixes:[/b] Of course! These are always ongoing tasks for us. We'll share more details with you once we make progress.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Ongoing Optimizations[/h1][p][/p][h2]Bot Performance Overhaul[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Comprehensive overhaul for bot performance, including but not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Improved Pathfinding[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Combat Logic[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced Difficulty Scaling[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Attachment System Refinement[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Further improvements to:[/p][list][*][p]Categorization[/p][/*][*][p]Statistical Clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Performance[/p][/*][*][p]Capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Description Texts[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Upcoming Bug Fixes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Valiant Ability Fixes[/h2][p][/p][olist][*][p]Vladimir[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where Vladimir's Field Fort could block vision in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Vladimir's Field Fort could not be interacted with right after deployment.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Uly[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where continuously attempting to activate Uly's Signature Ability while his Ultimate Ability is activated would cause the burrow entrance to disappear and his Tactical Ability to be incorrectly buffed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where switching to Ulymobile view after Uly activates his Tactical Ability, then turning sharply and repeatedly switching between Uly's view and Ulymobile's view, would cause the Ulymobile view direction to become inconsistent with the Ulymobile's travel direction.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Map & Environment Fixes[/h2][p][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue with redundant collision in some areas of Target C in The Crescent Bay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the training camp where the Hunter Crossbow couldn't deal damage to the target upon hitting the head, while shots to the body incorrectly registered as headshots.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Gameplay, System & UI Fixes[/h2][p][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue causing incorrect achievement pop-up triggers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bots could unreasonably turn 180 degrees and eliminate enemies behind them under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where non-squad members could hear squad voice chat.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]That's all for this episode! As always, don't forget to leave comments and talk to us about the things you care about the most! We hope you enjoy a nice weekend, and we'll see you in the next one! 🫶[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Producer Lantin: A Letter to the Community on Season 2 Launch
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/36cf9819040154a1651ee943e597f8579e6b0d6e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p]This is Lantin, the producer of Wild Assault.[/p][p]Can you believe it? It's been almost 3 months since the Wild Assault Early Access launch! I'm so glad that the studio has built an even deeper connection with our community. Just as it has for me, communicating with you and pouring our hearts into crafting content for you has already become the daily routine for everyone on the team, and we've been enjoying every moment of it! As the new season is launching today, I would like to take some time to talk about our journey so far, the wisdom you've taught us, and our resolve for this project's future.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Fast Responses and Continuous Improvements[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]Continuous improvement[/b] has always been our primary goal, ever since we first brought Wild Assault to the public in April 2024. Addressing community feedback regarding major issues in our initial build with [b]fast responses[/b] was our first priority. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/4184484271457011639"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Through 3 episodes of "[b]Updates on Player Concerns[/b]," we have significantly optimized Wild Assault's core player experiences:[/p][list][*][p]We removed the [b]Battle Pass XP cap[/b] and optimized task designs for better progression experiences.[/p][/*][*][p]We added more content to the Battle Pass without increasing the price, improving its [b]content value[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]We promised the community [b]a FOMO-free Battle Pass experience[/b] and began related R&D at the very beginning of Season 1.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506200990068769048"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506200344140710240"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/576005583301247947"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Regarding monetization[/b], when we first introduced the Haru Silk cosmetic bundle, the price tag didn't meet everyone's expectations. We realized that our early monetization strategy had significant room for improvement. After collecting valuable community feedback, we swiftly adjusted the pricing for related items the very next day and issued refunds accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506203515438236457"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I would like to thank everyone who shared their thoughts on social media, on Steam forum and in our official Discord server. The wisdom you've shared with us is precious. As we've mentioned before, [b]the studio strives to work with you in finding a balanced model that both sustains Wild Assault's development and ensures players can experience and enjoy the content we've poured our hearts into.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Throughout Season 1, our updates evolved as Wild Assault gradually stabilized. We started with an intense [b]daily hotfix[/b] pace for the first 2 weeks, and as the S1 build became more stable, we adjusted to a [b]weekly update[/b] schedule. This allowed us to shift more manpower to new content R&D.[/p][p][/p][p]We released over [b]20 hotfixes[/b] during Season 1, covering a wide range of bug fixes and optimizations, [b]including but not limited to Valiant collision optimizations, balancing, a new event (Kite Carnival), and 2 new game modes.[/b] At the same time, we shared our R&D progress and maintained close communication with the community through our weekly dev logs. [b]The comments you shared genuinely influenced our dev direction.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][quote][p][url="https://steamdb.info/app/2827230/patchnotes/"]https://steamdb.info/app/2827230/patchnotes/[/url][/p][/quote][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Focusing on Combat Experience Optimization[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Thanks to the community's continuous and valuable feedback[/b], we've introduced a major R&D focus shift during Season 1. We've prioritized addressing existing pain points within the current combat experience, redirecting some new content R&D resources towards optimizing combat fluidity. Most of these changes will be released in Season 2.[/p][p][/p][p]Although this focus shift means some new content, including new game modes we had prepared, will be postponed, [b]we still believe that only by ensuring the quality of the core gameplay experience can Wild Assault truly support richer new content yet to come.[/b] As you can see, we are, and always will be, optimizing our R&D workflow based on community's demands.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We know you care a lot about Wild Assault's Valiant and weapon balancing, and so do we. I can assure you that our team approaches adjustments to balancing with extreme caution, as each change could trigger a butterfly effect throughout the game.[/p][p][/p][p]During Season 1, we gradually determined our general balancing direction through [b]multiple rounds of feedback collection, in-depth discussions, and a large amount of internal testing.[/b] We announced our balancing plan through a dev log earlier, and more details were released together with the Season 2 patch notes. Please keep sharing your thoughts in the comments![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506206686159047385"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Honest Community Communication[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Wild Assault has always been a community driven project, and Combat Cat Studio remains committed to our founding principle of [b]honest communication[/b] with players. Although we won't be able to reply to each and every comment, taking in your feedback is always our top priority.[/p][p][/p][p]We are aware of your major concerns, such as a low concurrent player count, an unideal matchmaking mechanism, and a desperate need for new content to attract new players. These are the issues we must face and are looking to resolve. Given the current status of Wild Assault's lack of game content, we've seen it coming and were prepared for the current situation.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, everyone on the team is deeply touched and motivated by every active player in Wild Assault, the lively discussion on social media, and the fan art you have created. [b]Your continuous support deeply honors us, and we sincerely thank you for your company along Wild Assault's Early Access phase.[/b] Your voices and love have strengthened our determination to keep Wild Assault thriving long term![/p][p][/p][p]Good news is, through our combined efforts throughout the entire season, Wild Assault is getting better by the day. As Season 2 arrives, the team is committed to the following goals:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Keep close communication with the community, as always.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed up our R&D pace:[/b] We plan to release at least one new map each season to fulfill your gameplay experience needs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhance social functions:[/b] Clearly, our current squad function alone is far from meeting your expectations. Enhancing Wild Assault's social features (friends, squad, lobby, etc.) will be our next focus. More details will be revealed as our R&D progresses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore UGC potential.[/b] As mentioned earlier in a dev log, we are currently working on introducing the Steam Workshop function to Wild Assault. We will do our best to let the community's amazing creativity enliven the game. We will make sure to share the latest updates with you through our dev logs.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506204775462733784"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you again for everything. ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wild Assault Season 2: Phantom Fracture[/b] officially drops today. Good hunting Wild Ones! Hope to catch you on the battleground soon![/p][p]PS: Let me take advantage of being the producer here. I'm very eager to know what content you would like to see in Wild Assault. Don't hesitate to share your thoughts in the comments! I will carefully read them all. 😉[/p][p][/p][p]Lantin[/p][p]Wild Assault Producer[/p][p]July 3, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Early Access Season 2: Phantom Fracture Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="f_o0vRVSk24;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Wild Assault Early Access Season 2: Phantom Fracture[/b] launches on July 3![/p][p]The new season introduces a new Valiant - Crock, a new map - The Impel Sandbar, new weapons, systems, and cosmetics, as well as new summer themed events, balance adjustments, important bug fixes and optimizations![/p][p][b]The update is scheduled at 7 AM PT on July 3.[/b] Ingame matches won't be affected by this update. However matchmaking may not function normally during the process. Please exit the game, complete the update, and launch your game client again.[/p][p][/p][h1]Season 2: Phantom Fracture[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/86f6be6dcac7c0a05355ed0e1a13734c7ad6bc3b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][quote][p]Gradually losing interest in his boring assignments, Crock left the intel organization he previously worked for, searching for true rivals. As a former assassin, Crock believes that slaughter is the only truth. The global conflict over Feral Relics piqued his interest, so he used his recon expertise to gather intel on them and sell it at a high price on the black market. Upon learning of this, The Desolate Legion immediately sent Ryan and Vladimir to The Crescent Bay to deal with Crock. In the meantime, a dissident faction within The Desolate Legion secretly began to take action, seeking an opportunity to seize the intel on Feral Relics. The fracture appears, and what's untold slowly began to unfold.[/p][/quote][/p][h1]New Valiant: Crock - The Mire Butcher[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="QXLZPZzI-s4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][quote][p]Whether in the past or present, Crock has always been the ultimate hunter. The only difference now is that his prey has shifted from politicians to soldiers.[/p][p]His exceptional combat skills and lightning-fast adaptability make him unstoppable on every mission. Even the most secure defense systems crumble before him like paper. His talents quickly earned him a reputation as the organization's most sought-after assassin, with high-priority and challenging contracts flooding in one after another.[/p][p]However, he gradually lost interest through countless "mind-numbingly boring" assignments, until he insisted on quitting and found himself on the organization's hit list. The experience of fighting other trained killers in life-or-death battles reignited his desire for combat. Compared to defenseless politicians, skilled opponents offered far more excitement and challenge.[/p][p]After effortlessly escaping the assassin organization's pursuit, he received an offer from the Desolate Legion. This time, he accepted with genuine enthusiasm.[/p][/quote][/p][h1]New Map: The Impel Sandbar[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/bf38c7b10560e5ccbb14564dda2181eca5f1e022.png"][/img][/p][p][quote][p]The scorching sun bakes the cracked salt flats, sand hisses in the wind, while steel wrecks lie silent as tombs.[/p][/quote][/p][h1]New Weapons[/h1][list][*][p]Assault Rifles[/p][list][*][p]AKS[/p][/*][*][p]AL-01[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pistol[/p][list][*][p]CA50[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]LMG[/p][list][*][p]M2[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Special[/p][list][*][p]Hunter Crossbow[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/576011306176349101"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]New System: Achievements[/h1][p][/p][p][b]The Achievement System is now live[/b], featuring 2 main categories: [b]Achievements and Challenges[/b]. Multiple types of achievements are included, such as [b]Battle Honors, Milestones, Fun Times, Weapon, Class, and Valiant achievements[/b], spicing up your gameplay![/p][p]Unlocking achievements to get [b]Beast Tags[/b] and [b]Weapon XP Cards[/b] as rewards! Some specific achievements will also grant you special [b]Medals and Weapon Cosmetics[/b]![/p][p]Complete special achievement progression tasks to earn exclusive rewards: [b]Norman - Sky Cavalry Valiant Cosmetics, and the Supreme Series Avatars, Name Tags & Medals![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Project Sextans S2[/h1][p][/p][p]The Project Sextans S2 will include 2 separate phases throughout Season 2, with [b]shorter duration and doubled rewards per phase![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Season 2 Battle Pass[/h1][p][/p][p]Brand new Battle Pass tasks, with [b]upgraded Advanced Battle Pass rewards![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]New Events[/h1][p][/p][p]A whole new series of events await, including the [b]Dead Drop[/b] event, [b]Black Ledger[/b] event, [b]Summer Surf[/b] event and more![/p][p]Complete event tasks to get [b]Valiant Cosmetics[/b], [b]Weapon Cosmetics[/b], [b]Beast Tags[/b], [b]Proficiency Boost[/b], [b]Weapon XP Cards[/b], and much more![/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][list][*][p][b]Marquez - Tropical Mint Bundle[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/9f6706e00c8d708e7f36205329e1490801f7c39f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Jack - Costa Groove Bundle[/b] coming August 14. Stay tuned![/p][/*][/list][h1]Optimizations[/h1][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Experience[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlocking All Valiants:[/b] Based on community feedback, we've decided to unlock all Valiants for every player starting in Season 2! We will refund the Beast Tags players spent to unlock Valiants during Season 1. Please allow us 3 business days to complete this process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items Unlockable with Beast Tags:[/b] To increase the value of the Beast Tags you've earned, we will gradually release 2 sets of cosmetics that can be unlocked with Beast Tags during Season 2! More Beast Tag unlockable items are on the way. Stay tuned![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Battle Pass System:[/b] As promised earlier in the dev logs, starting in Season 2, all players will be able to switch between different Battle Passes to progress at their own pace! The Season 1 Battle Pass will also be available to new players who join Wild Assault during Season 2.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized VFX for certain Valiant notes.title: Wild Assault Valiant Spotlight: Crock - The Mire Butcher
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="QXLZPZzI-s4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Lore[/h1][p][/p][p][quote][p]Whether in the past or present, Crock has always been the ultimate hunter. The only difference now is that his prey has shifted from politicians to soldiers.[/p][p]His exceptional combat skills and lightning-fast adaptability make him unstoppable on every mission. Even the most secure defense systems crumble before him like paper. His talents quickly earned him a reputation as the organization's most sought-after assassin, with high-priority and challenging contracts flooding in one after another.[/p][p]However, he gradually lost interest through countless "mind-numbingly boring" assignments, until he insisted on quitting and found himself on the organization's hit list. The experience of fighting other trained killers in life-or-death battles reignited his desire for combat. Compared to defenseless politicians, skilled opponents offered far more excitement and challenge.[/p][p]After effortlessly escaping the assassin organization's pursuit, he received an offer from the Desolate Legion. This time, he accepted with genuine enthusiasm.[/p][/quote][/p][h1]Abilities Description[/h1][list][*][p]PASSIVE - [b]Terror Spreads[/b][/p][list][*][p]When Crock successfully eliminates a target, he collects intel the enemy dropped to reveal all nearby enemy units for a short period of time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]SIGNATURE - [b]Dark Water Strike[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crock gets ready to ambush enemies and removes all targeting/unveiling debuffs. While the ability is active, Crock moves slowly and applies a hunt mark to the nearest enemy unit. Use LMB to launch a death roll to dash forward and deal massive damage to enemies along the way. The death roll gains significantly increased range when targeting an enemy with a hunt mark.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]TACTICAL - [b]Tomahawk![/b][/p][list][*][p]Crock throws a retrievable tomahawk towards his target. Successfully taking down enemies with this ability will trigger the Terror Spreads passive for Crock, revealing all nearby enemy units around the eliminated target for a certain period of time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]ULTIMATE - [b]Hunting Feast[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Let the feast begin!" Crock enters full hunting mode, activating thermal vision to sense all nearby enemy units through objects. While the ability is active, Crock gains increased movement speed, significantly increased crouched movement speed, and silenced footsteps. Successful takedowns extend the ability duration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #29: Balancing, balancing and balancing!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/4da53fa263833a6113ce7554222ad3ebd62cfdaf.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p]Wild Assault Season 1 is coming to an end soon! As our first Early Access season, we've delivered [b]20 live updates[/b] with key improvements including character collision fixes and Battle Pass system refinements.[/p][p]As teased in last week's dev log, today we're diving deeper into the [b]Season 2 balance adjustments[/b]! These changes resulted from multiple rounds of in-depth studio discussions, where we finalized the core direction. We'll continue refining specifics through ongoing optimizations.[/p][p][/p][h2]1. Valiant Balancing[/h2][p][/p][h3]1.1. Basic Specs Adjustment[/h3][list][*][p]Lowered basic HP for large Valiants, including Ryan, Vladimir and Zhenshan: 200 → 180.[/p][/*][/list][h3]1.2. Hongying: The Medic Angel[/h3][list][*][p][b]First Aid Capsule (Q)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Significantly reduced the wind-up time for tossing the capsule.[/p][/*][*][p]New trait: Retrieving the capsule now resets the cooldown of her E ability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.3. Marquez: The Deadly Toxin[/h3][list][*][p][b]Gas Grenade (Q)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Significantly reduced the wind-up time for launching the gas grenade.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall ability VFX & SFX quality, and enhanced ability activation player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Toxin Trap (E)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Marquez's mines no longer detonate when defused by enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Marquez's mines now chain react and detonate other mines within the explosion radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall ability VFX & SFX quality, and enhanced ability activation player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.4. Vladimir: The Righteous Flame[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fury Cannon (Z)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the explosion falloff range, reduced splash damage, and reduced the explosion radius.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.5. Ryan: The Tough Cop[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smoke Grenade (Q)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the ability's cooldown and duration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reckless Charge (E)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced initial sprint speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed attack detection during the speed-up phase. Ryan will no longer knock down or deal damage to enemies during the initial acceleration of his charge.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Repression (Z)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ryan can now extend the ultimate's duration through successful takedowns.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.6. Jack: The Sharp Tracker[/h3][list][*][p][b]T-28 Projectile Launcher (Q)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Significantly reduced the wind-up time for launching the projectile.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]H-6 "Bloodhunt" (E)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scan distance: 75m → 110m. (1m≈3.28ft)[/p][/*][*][p]Jack's movement is no longer restricted while the ability is activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]D-37 Wolf Pack Artillery (Z)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Jack's movement is no longer restricted while activating the ability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.7. Akai Hime[/h3][list][*][p][b]Departure (E)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the slide & melee damage: 110 → 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Sliding within the effective range of ENCOUNTER (Q) now grants her an additional stealth effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Enigma (Z)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies will now be disarmed for a short period of time if they hit the decoy left by Akai Hime's slide while her Ultimate is activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.8. Uly: The Land Diver[/h3][list][*][p][b]Uly's Scuba Party (Z)[/b][/p][list][*][p]The SN3100 Ulymobile now moves faster while Uly's Ultimate is activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of only squadmates, Uly's entire team can now use the holes created by his "Land Diving" ability as deploy beacons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]1.9. Zhenshan - The Vanguard Will[/h3][list][*][p]Passive[/p][list][*][p]Jumping during ability casting is no longer restricted. You can now activate Zhenshan's rolling by pressing the tactical sprint key, and it will cost additional stamina.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]2. Weapon Balancing[/h2][p]Once again, we'd like to communicate with you on our weapon balancing philosophy:[/p][list][*][p][b]Main approach:[/b] Our idea is to create differentiated weapon designs that highlight each weapon's strengths and weaknesses, establishing a distinctive, balanced ecosystem where weapons counter each other in a stable and healthy way.[/p][/*][/list][p]To make that happen, we've made detailed plans covering multiple aspects regarding specific weapon balancing tasks:[/p][list][*][p][b]Redefining weapon roles[/b] to address assault rifles being severely outclassed.[/p][list][*][p]Buff [b]SMGs[/b] at close range while reducing their mid to long-range effectiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhance [b]assault rifles'[/b] mid to long-range performance (reduce spread, increase late-stage recoil, fine-tune recoil patterns).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Optimizing DMRs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improve sustained long-range precision.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce spread.[/p][/*][*][p]Differentiate DMRs through unique recoil patterns.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Snipers:[/b] Further fine-tune damage capability at long range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-tune weapon [b]ADS delay[/b] and [b]ready-up times[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Rework problematic weapons: Resolve balance issues caused by unclear positioning of [b]shotguns and machine guns[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimize damage distribution across different body parts[/b]: Prevent arms from acting as "chest shields" that block weapon damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attachment System Overhaul[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Remove unreasonable attachments from certain weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalance attachment stats to reduce excessive negative attributes.[/p][/*][*][p]Clarify attachment roles to reduce confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Create a more intuitive system that better supports weapon performance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]For us, balance is an ongoing journey. Moving forward, we will continue making regular dynamic adjustments focused on player experience. We always welcome players to share their thoughts and suggestions about Valiants and weapon experience in Wild Assault![/p][p][/p][h2]3. Upcoming Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][p]Finally, we've fixed those bugs you've all been asking about in our internal builds. However, these fixes still carry some major stability risks. We're planning more internal testing rounds to make sure everything runs smoothly before release. [b]You can expect these bug fixes to go live with Season 2.[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed the incorrect M88 ammo count when reloading an empty magazine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Home Defender's bullet count was behaving abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the WA Raid mode where deploying during point capture would make both objectives and teammates disappear from the deployment screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn't interact with certain event related items after reconnecting from a network disconnection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera stuck on the deployment screen after reconnecting from network disconnection, preventing player from controlling the Valiant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed deployment screen errors caused by unsynchronized variables during high-latency conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Marquez's E ability collided with the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapon models would unexpectedly disappear when triggered by a melee attack while equipping a weapon attachment that modifies magazine capacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where equipping the extended magazine on the PPSH-45 did not function properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Erwin's PPSH-45 equipped with an extended drum displayed incorrect ammo counts after activating Q ability and switching back to primary weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Erwin’s Q ability healing SFX would incorrectly persist when switching weapons during the ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Erwin’s Q ability (Revive) would fail to activate under high-latency conditions.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]That's all for this episode! notes.title: Wild Assault Dev Log #28: New Weapons Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Wild Ones![/p][p][/p][p][b]#TGIF![/b][/p][p]In our June 12 update patch note, we explained the pause of weekly updates. We are currently in the sprint phase of finalizing the Season 2 content. Regarding the community reported bugs, we have collected them all and scheduled fixes. To ensure game stability and prevent new issues, we will focus on testing and finalizing the new season build, balance adjustments, and bug fixes over the next 3 weeks. Most of the issues will be addressed in the upcoming Season 2 update.[/p][p]We appreciate your understanding and support, and we look forward to providing a more stable gaming experience in the future![/p][p]As promised, today we bring you the scheduled weekly dev log![/p][p]
[/p][h1]1. Season 2 New Weapons 🔫[/h1][p][/p][p]The 5 new weapons launching in Season 2 are: [b]AKS, AL-01, CA50, M2, and the Hunter Crossbow[/b].[/p][p]Based on player demands in large-scale battleground combat, where they need to adapt to dynamic scenarios and varying engagement distances, [b]our Season 2 weapon design philosophy primarily focuses on bridging the weapon ecosystem between different classes.[/b] Our goal is to enable players to play as their favorite Valiants while maintaining the flexibility to respond to various situations. The AKS, AL-01, and CA50 were all born from this design philosophy.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've introduced new weapons that encourage diverse gameplay styles:[/p][olist][*][p]The [b]Hunter Crossbow[/b] provides a unique stealth play style, offering absolute advantages in flanking and ambush tactics.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]M2 machine gun[/b] specializes in sustained fire suppression at medium to long ranges.[/p][/*][/olist][p]With the addition of new weapons, we know everyone's main concern is still [b]weapon balance[/b]. After reviewing player feedback and internal discussions, we're working hard on a major round of balance changes and optimizations that will affect core gun feel and weapon balance. The adjustments include but are not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Weapon recoil[/p][/*][*][p]Spread patterns[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet velocity[/p][/*][*][p]Damage values[/p][/*][*][p]Damage falloff curves[/p][/*][*][p]Attachment system optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to each Valiant's available weapon selection[/p][/*][/list][p]And more...[/p][p]These optimizations will go live with the Season 2 update. We'll share the specific balance adjustment details with you in the next episode![/p][p][/p][h2]1.1 AKS[/h2][olist][*][p][b]IRL Reference - AKS-74U:[/b] The AKS-74U is a short-barrel assault rifle designed by the Izhmash design team, based on the AKS-74. It was modified and improved to meet the portability requirements of different military units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Philosophy:[/b] We aim to highlight its streamlined frame's versatility and portability, ensuring diverse weapon choices for characters in specific combat scenarios.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/db095e99dd0af3c0f1c4a1ce344d07e14382be88.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h2]1.2 AL-01[/h2][olist][*][p][b]IRL Reference - FAL Rifle:[/b] The FAL is a rifle designed by FN Herstal, officially entering production and service in 1953. Due to its excellent compatibility with 7.62×51mm full-power cartridges, this rifle has been used by over 90 countries worldwide and manufactured by 10 countries.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Philosophy:[/b] A reliable rifle that delivers precise strikes against enemies at medium range through stable burst fire and excellent shooting accuracy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/a6f060d4fe41f94adf96014bfd94191effe1e26f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h2]1.3 CA50[/h2][olist][*][p][b]IRL Reference - Desert Eagle:[/b] The famous Desert Eagle. A large-caliber pistol developed by Magnum Research and refined by Israel Military Industries. The weapon was developed in 1979 and finalized for mass production in 1983.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Philosophy:[/b] The CA50 is a powerful weapon. It gives you confidence just by holding it. The CA50's characteristics clearly make it an ace weapon for close-range combat, but we still hope to leverage its massive firepower to allow players to handle some medium-range combat when using it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/306372dd173f4e91e4d5f3a787ddb6eb92e65709.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h2]1.4 M2[/h2][olist][*][p][b]IRL Reference - M2 Browning Heavy Machine Gun:[/b] Its predecessor, the M1921, was designed by John Moses Browning and standardized in 1921. Continuous improvements were made to address the barrel overheating issue. Additionally, the M2 machine gun has been adapted into vehicle-mounted and aircraft-mounted variants, and has been used by over 50 countries worldwide.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Philosophy:[/b] A low fire rate machine gun capable of sustained damage output. In medium to long-range engagements, it excels with its high damage advantage and stability. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/1fff257724af11897c52df34d39869c298bdd037.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][h2]1.5 Hunter Crossbow[/h2][olist][*][p][b]IRL Reference - PSE Tactical Assault Crossbow TAC-15:[/b] Manufactured by PSE Company in the United States, it is currently the world's fastest crossbow in terms of bolt velocity. This crossbow features excellent ergonomics and good accuracy, and is equipped with a pistol grip and rail system that allows for weapon accessory attachments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Philosophy:[/b] A medium-range stealth weapon that provides precise aiming and effective damage output. In future development, we will introduce various bolt types with different damage mechanics to maximize the crossbow's functionality and make it more fun to use.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899972/7cf0bda482e52730a4ed346a1c2276e7e3808788.png"][/img] [/p][/*][/olist][h1]2. Optimization Status ⚙️[/h1][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Battle Pass System:[/b] R&D addressing community's FOMO concern is completed. The new system will go live before Season 2 launch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability targeting indicators[/b] no longer blocked by teammate models (in development).[/p][/*][*][p][b]3C Optimization:[/b] (Character, Camera & Control), including movement interrupt logic and mantling interruption improvements (development completed).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Game Mode:[/b] Added map-specific options and improved matchmaking logic (development completed).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability input restriction system[/b] optimization (development completed).[/p][olist][*][p]Tactical sprint key input optimization.[/p][/*][*][p]Valiant animation and weapon state matching optimization.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][h1]3. Upcoming Bug Fixes 🛠️[/h1][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn't interact with the event objects after reconnecting from a network disconnection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera stuck on the deployment screen after reconnecting from network disconnection, preventing player from controlling the Valiant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed deployment screen errors caused by unsynchronized variables during high-latency conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Marquez's E ability collided with the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapon models would unexpectedly disappear when triggered by a melee attack while equipping a weapon attachment that modifies magazine capacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect M88 ammo count when reloading an empty magazine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Home Defender's bullet count was behaving abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where equipping the extended magazine on the PPSH-45 did not function properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several terrain issues in The Crescent Bay where areas were not properly covered by the non-safe zone.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]That's all for today! Hope you have a great weekend ahead! We'll talk to you again in the next episode, where we'll go into detail about our upcoming weapon balance plans! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Combat Cat Studio[/p][p][/p][h3]Follow us on social media ⤵️[/h3]

Here's a little secret: the ingame 3D model looks amazing too! 🐊😉[/p][p]We've noticed many discussions regarding new maps on the Steam forum and in our community. New Map 🗺️[/h1][p][/p][p]The highly anticipated new map is nearly completed! As we mentioned before, we wanted our early maps to offer diverse combat experiences. [b]Following our high-mobility, terrain-varied, and multi-platform map designs, the latest map will deliver a more linear assault experience.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][quote][p][b]Designer's Note:[/b] Within the brutal stronghold of Map 4, towering cold walls leave no room for flanking maneuvers. Valiants must rely on direct, aggressive combat tactics to conquer their rivals.[/p][/quote][/p][p][b](Note: We also continue adjusting parts of the terrain structure based on actual gameplay testing. The attacking team must focus their firepower to break through defensive lines, while defenders must hold every gateway at all costs, building walls of victory from fallen challengers.
